diagnoses.title: Resource quota exceeded
diagnoses.summary: web cannot create pods: the preview's resource quota is exhausted (requested limits.cpu=500m; used limits.cpu=6100m of limits.cpu=6500m)
diagnoses.subject: deployment/web
diagnoses.suggestion: The preview's quota is sized from heimdall.yaml, so this happens when something adds pods beyond it (a manual scale, extra replicas, a stuck rollout keeping old pods). Remove the extra pods, or raise `resources` in heimdall.yaml within the tenant's limits.
evidence: FailedCreate: Error creating: pods "web-c556bf97c-qrl2h" is forbidden: exceeded quota: heimdall-quota, requested: limits.cpu=500m, used: limits.cpu=6100m, limited: limits.cpu=6500m
